_comment: Facts for the companies directory (web/companies.html). Sizes are employee bands worldwide and, like founding years, approximate — re-check now and then. 'startup' = independent, venture-backed, founded 2009 or later, under 5,000 people. 'name' must match the company name on job posts (legal suffixes like GmbH/AG/Inc are ignored); add other spellings to 'aliases'.
